display_name: Flavio dos Santos's safehouse, Mallagra St. (Rancho Coronado)
why: A run-down two-storey house with a garage off Mallagra St. in Rancho Coronado, used by Going-away Party (sts_std_rcr_03, Muamar Reyes) as 6th Street victim Flavio dos Santos's hideout. Vanilla stages the aftermath there through the street story's own phases: the openworld phase switches on Flavio, an eight-strong 6th Street crew with two Archer Hellas, and five terrified sex workers at execution/afraid workspots, and the gameplay phase runs the search, the turret and the drive to the Aldecaldo pickup. None of that section loads in the clean slate. This proposal restores the house as a 6th Street house before the purge: Flavio at home upstairs and his crew hanging around the house and the parked cars, with the massacre staging (victims, corpses, glitched turret, escape car, nomad pickup) left out. Owner decision 131 and venue-node-policy section 4: omit the one-off gig target Flavio.

open_questions: Confirm Flavio is upstairs in the bedroom standing and waiting at his appear spot, not lying wounded, kneeling or missing.
Check the 6th Street crew are spread around the house and the two parked Hellas (leaning, smoking, on the phone, on the stairs, patrolling) rather than standing in a stack at one spawner point.
Check whether the crew turns hostile as you approach; note it, since a 6th Street house may be meant to read that way.
Walk in without the gig: try the front door, the back door, the garage gate and the crawlspace under the house, and say which one worked.
Look for an execution or street-violence vignette in the yard (a civilian plus gang members) and report it if the openworld prefab stages one.
Confirm the house shows outside_rcr_03: no corpses, no glitched turret and no explosive tanks, just the normal fridge/laptop/coffee-machine/sprinkler props.
Read the DoorPolicy lines for #rcr_03_main_door and #rcr_03_garage_gate to confirm the doors are enabled and powered.

variant_toggles.why: outside_rcr_03 is the house outside the gig: normal appliances and props (fridge, coffee machine, laptop, radio, sprinklers) and no massacre dressing. The during_rcr_03 set is the staged gig state, whose device prefab children include the two wa_corpse props, the glitched turret and the small explosive tank. The openworld phase's reset branch shows outside=1/during=0 and its setup branch shows the opposite, so setting outside=1 explicitly gives the before-anything-happened house even if the variant default were during.

proximity_wait.why: The garage gate is a DoorControllerPS device vanilla drives at this venue, it streams with the house on the street side where the player arrives, and its tag is unique in the catalogue (the front door tag #rcr_03_main_door is carried by two different single_door nodes).
